ABOUT THIS EDITION

The project, working in your browser.

This edition runs the original capstone’s Python ranking class and text-cleaning helpers through Pyodide. The interface and example roles are adapted for the portfolio. The full Streamlit project includes additional résumé formats, job API integrations, and human-judgment evaluation.

The small browser dataset uses min_df=1 and max_df=1.0. Different datasets and settings will produce different rankings.
